name: Snowflake Horizon Catalog
sku: Snowflake Standard edition. Governance and quality features that need the Enterprise edition carry an enterprise-tier constraint, so they count as a remedy and never as coverage.

bands.note: Horizon Catalog is Snowflake's catalog for data inside and outside Snowflake, connecting external data through Iceberg and external tables and adding semantic views, auto-generated descriptions and object tagging. The overview names no edition limit, but the editions page says some tagging features need Enterprise.

Discretionary and role-based access control: objects have owners who grant privileges to roles, roles go to users, and roles inherit. Row-level restriction is a separate Enterprise feature, scored under policy.
Column-level security applies masking policies to columns in tables or views. Listed on the editions page as Enterprise edition or higher.

Row access policies decide which rows a query can see, and data classification identifies potentially sensitive data. Both are listed as Enterprise edition or higher, and some tagging features need Enterprise too.

Lineage at table and column level, upstream and downstream, across tables, views, dynamic tables, Iceberg tables, semantic views, stages and ML objects, for impact analysis. An Enterprise edition feature.

Data metric functions measure attributes such as null counts or freshness, and expectations flag results outside an acceptable range. They run on a schedule, hourly by default, and need the Enterprise edition.
Anomaly detection learns from history to flag a metric above or below its predicted range. It currently supports volume and freshness metrics, and needs the Enterprise edition.

presentation.tagline: Catalog, access control, masking, lineage and data quality for Snowflake data.
